[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Plan annotated archives and selective highlight links[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]archive[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]archive: Extend the existing read-only overwrite plan with an annotated [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]archive bundle, frozen metadata and assets, and highlight-only inbound [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]link rewrites. Establish the shared archive metadata reader. Keep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]annotated execution refused until the execute phase.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hold scans that encounter a replaced annotated PDF[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after archive[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: Use the archived PDF evidence to hold a restored old PDF before [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync can import annotations, change tasks, or repair its marker. Cover [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]human and JSON scan, explicit sync, dry-run behavior, and a race before [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]execution; keep ordinary scans unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Recover transactions that renamed annotated bundles[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recovery[dim] · [dim][/dim]after archive[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery: Extend the host-local overwrite intent and recovery to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]describe no-clobber PDF and asset moves, reverse them safely on failure,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and preserve unexpected late editor writes. Retain version-1 intent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compatibility. Keep production annotated overwrite disabled; exercise [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery with synthetic interrupted transactions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Enable coordinated annotated overwrite[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]execute[dim] · [dim][/dim]after archive, guard, recovery[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]execute: Replace the annotated interim refusal with the Mac/config gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and consume the prepared archive, link, scan-guard, and recovery [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contracts in the existing transaction. Rename the PDF and assets under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]one bounded merging coordination, preserve reading-task identity, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]verify or roll back the complete change. Add fake-coordinator [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]transaction and hold tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify user behavior and extend Mac acceptance documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after execute[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: Add cross-cutting recapture regressions, pin processed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]annotation identity, extend the isolated Highlights acceptance kit, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update create/sync docs. Run the prescribed local gates and prepare [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]evidence for the child epic land agent. Real Highlights acceptance is a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]manual Mac step, never a Linux claim.[/#D7D7AF]
